items.label: Soft Fabric
items.value: Our bean bag chairs sofa is made of faux fur fabric that is cozy enough. The memory foam is high-density that can provides great support to you. And the cover is easy to remove and can be machine-washable without shrinking

items.label: Thoughtful Details
items.value: Hobestluk lounger chair is matched with a Ottoman, you can put your feet on it and totally relax yourself. It is wide enough to hold you and it is also convenient to fold the ottoman onto the chair, which can save storage space

items.label: Non-Assembly
items.value: This comfy chaise lounger requires no assembly at all, just remove the vaccum package and allow it 24-48 hours to regain resilience. After total expansion, you can recline and relax yourself on it

items.label: Ergonomic Design
items.value: The beanbag chair for adults is ergonomically designed, comfortable and comfy, providing good back, neck and head support for a relaxing experience. When you unwind on Hobestluk lounger sofa, making you feel like you're sink into a cloud

items.label: Various Applications
items.value: The big bean bag lounger sofa is great addition to your home, bedroom, living room and dorm. You can read books, play games, lie down or spend time with family on our chair
